hypothesis: If sunflower spirals intersect isogonally and orthogonally only rarely, measured crossing angles between the two spiral families are constant within a head and only a minority of heads show 90° crossings.
pass_criterion: Not applicable: no verified public dataset.
interpretation: The test needs measured crossing angles between the two families of spirals (parastichies) in sunflower heads, with the fraction crossing at 90° versus other constant angles. That requires image-derived angle measurements from sunflower capitula.
no_dataset_reason: I know of no public, citable dataset of measured parastichy crossing angles for sunflower discs that I can verify with a working landing URL or DOI. Raw floret-position datasets exist only in individual papers whose identifiers I could not confirm, and I will not invent one.
